scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.stop: npm run docker:down && (pkill -f 'node|next-server' || echo 'Processos locais já encerrados')
scripts.db:migrate: docker exec reis_backend_v2 npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: docker exec reis_backend_v2 npx prisma db seed
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint || true && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test -- --forceExit --detectOpenHandles || true && npm --prefix frontend test
